name: Uptime Kuma
description: A self-hosted uptime and status-page monitor for websites and services.
compose:
services:
  uptime-kuma:
    image: louislam/uptime-kuma:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data
    ports:
      - "3001:3001"

name: Miniflux
description: A minimalist RSS/Atom feed reader backed by PostgreSQL; no admin account exists until you run `miniflux -create-admin` inside the container after first start.
compose:
services:
  miniflux:
    image: miniflux/miniflux:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8280:8080"
    depends_on:
      - db
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://miniflux:secret@db/miniflux?sslmode=disable
      - RUN_MIGRATIONS=1
  db:
    image: postgres:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=miniflux
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret
      - POSTGRES_DB=miniflux
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/postgresql

name: IT-Tools
description: A collection of handy browser-based utilities for developers, with no persistent data of its own.
compose:
services:
  it-tools:
    image: corentinth/it-tools:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"

name: Jellyfin
description: A free media server for streaming movies, shows, and music from your own library to any device.
compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8096:8096"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./cache:/cache
      - ./media:/media

name: Navidrome
description: A music streaming server that indexes your personal audio library behind a Subsonic-compatible web interface.
compose:
services:
  navidrome:
    image: deluan/navidrome:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "4533:4533"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./music:/music:ro

name: qBittorrent
description: A BitTorrent client with a web interface; the image defaults to a non-root user, so the config directory may need its ownership adjusted before it can write.
compose:
services:
  qbittorrent:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - WEBUI_PORT=8081
      - TORRENTING_PORT=6881
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./downloads:/downloads
    ports:
      - "8081:8081"
      - "6881:6881"
      - "6881:6881/udp"

name: Node-RED
description: A flow-based tool for wiring together IoT and home-automation devices and APIs; the image runs as uid 1000, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  node-red:
    image: nodered/node-red:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "1880:1880"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

name: Paperless-ngx
description: A document scanner and archive that OCRs and tags paperwork, run here with SQLite and a Valkey broker instead of PostgreSQL.
compose:
services:
  broker:
    image: docker.io/valkey/valkey:9-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./redisdata:/data
  webserver:
    image: ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - broker
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/usr/src/paperless/data
      - ./media:/usr/src/paperless/media
      - ./export:/usr/src/paperless/export
      - ./consume:/usr/src/paperless/consume
    environment:
      - PAPERLESS_REDIS=redis://broker:6379
      - PAPERLESS_DBENGINE=sqlite

name: Trilium Notes
description: A hierarchical personal notes app with rich formatting; the image runs as a non-root node user, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  trilium:
    image: triliumnext/trilium:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TRILIUM_DATA_DIR=/home/node/trilium-data
    ports:
      - "8082:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./trilium-data:/home/node/trilium-data

name: Gitea
description: A lightweight self-hosted Git service using SQLite, no external database needed; the image defaults to uid 1000, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  gitea:
    image: docker.gitea.com/gitea:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ./gitea:/data
    ports:
      - "3200:3000"
      - "2222:22"

name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: A reverse proxy with a web UI for issuing TLS certificates and routing traffic to other self-hosted apps by domain name.
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: jc21/nginx-proxy-manager:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
      - "81:81"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - ./letsencrypt:/etc/letsencrypt

name: Homepage
description: A customizable start-page dashboard that links out to your self-hosted services; set HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS to the address you browse it from.
compose:
services:
  homepage:
    image: ghcr.io/gethomepage/homepage:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3030:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/app/config
    environment:
      - HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS=localhost:3030

name: Nextcloud
description: A self-hosted file sync and collaboration platform, run here with its community-maintained image and default SQLite database.
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: nextcloud:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8083:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/html

name: Syncthing
description: A peer-to-peer file synchronization tool with no central server; the image runs as uid 1000, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  syncthing:
    image: syncthing/syncthing:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    hostname: syncthing
    ports:
      - "8384:8384"
      - "22000:22000"
      - "22000:22000/udp"
      - "21027:21027/udp"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/syncthing

name: Duplicati
description: A backup client that encrypts and uploads files to local or cloud storage, with its web UI unlocked by a token from the container logs.
compose:
services:
  duplicati:
    image: duplicati/duplicati:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8200:8200"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

name: Vaultwarden
description: A lightweight, Bitwarden-compatible password manager server; signups default to off, set SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=true to add your first account, then flip it back.
compose:
services:
  vaultwarden:
    image: vaultwarden/server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - SIGNUPS_ALLOWED=false
    ports:
      - "8087:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

name: Actual Budget
description: A local-first personal budgeting app with a web UI for tracking accounts and transactions.
compose:
services:
  actual:
    image: actualbudget/actual-server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5006:5006"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data

name: Linkding
description: A minimalist bookmark manager with tagging and full-text search; no admin account exists until you create one via its interactive setup after first start.
compose:
services:
  linkding:
    image: sissbruecker/linkding:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/etc/linkding/data

name: ntfy
description: A pub-sub notification service for pushing alerts to phones and desktops over HTTP.
compose:
services:
  ntfy:
    image: binwiederhier/ntfy:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
      - serve
    environment:
      - NTFY_CACHE_FILE=/var/cache/ntfy/cache.db
      - NTFY_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8085
    ports:
      - "8085:80"
    volumes:
      - ./cache:/var/cache/ntfy

name: Portainer
description: A web UI for managing Docker containers, images, and volumes; it requires access to the host's Docker socket to work at all.
compose:
services:
  portainer:
    image: portainer/portainer-ce:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9443:9443"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock

name: Vikunja
description: A self-hosted to-do and project manager; files and db need uid-1000 ownership, and sessions reset on restart unless VIKUNJA_SERVICE_SECRET is set.
compose:
services:
  vikunja:
    image: vikunja/vikunja:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL=http://localhost:3456/
    ports:
      - "3456:3456"
    volumes:
      - ./files:/app/vikunja/files
      - ./db:/db

name: Grafana
description: A dashboarding and visualization tool for metrics and logs; the image runs as a non-root uid, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3300:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/grafana

name: PhotoPrism
description: An AI-powered photo manager for a personal library, using SQLite by default; no admin password is set, so run `photoprism passwd admin` after first start.
compose:
services:
  photoprism:
    image: photoprism/photoprism:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "2342:2342"
    volumes:
      - ./originals:/photoprism/originals
      - ./storage:/photoprism/storage

name: Mealie
description: A recipe manager and meal planner with a web UI; the image defaults to a non-root uid, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  mealie:
    image: ghcr.io/mealie-recipes/mealie:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "9925:9000"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data/

name: FreshRSS
description: A lightweight self-hosted RSS/Atom feed aggregator with a web UI and a built-in SQLite database.
compose:
services:
  freshrss:
    image: freshrss/freshrss:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8380:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/FreshRSS/data

name: Pi-hole
description: A network-wide DNS sinkhole that blocks ads and trackers for every device; the web UI password is random unless FTLCONF_webserver_api_password is set.
compose:
services:
  pihole:
    image: pihole/pihole:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "53:53/tcp"
      - "53:53/udp"
      - "8090:80/tcp"
    environment:
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode=ALL
    volumes:
      - ./etc-pihole:/etc/pihole

name: Home Assistant
description: A home automation hub for smart-home devices; it uses host networking for discovery, so it has no published port, and USB dongles need extra passthrough.
compose:
services:
  homeassistant:
    image: ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config

name: n8n
description: A workflow automation platform with a visual editor and 400+ integrations; it runs as a non-root user, so its data may need its ownership adjusted.
compose:
services:
  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - N8N_SECURE_COOKIE=false
    ports:
      - "5678:5678"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/home/node/.n8n

name: Photoview
description: A simple, fast photo gallery that indexes a read-only photo library into a MariaDB database for browsing.
compose:
services:
  photoview:
    image: viktorstrate/photoview:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8060:80"
    environment:
      - PHOTOVIEW_DATABASE_DRIVER=mysql
      - PHOTOVIEW_MYSQL_URL=photoview:photoview@tcp(db)/photoview
      - PHOTOVIEW_MEDIA_CACHE=/app/cache
    volumes:
      - ./photos:/photos:ro
      - ./cache:/app/cache
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: mariadb:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - MARIADB_DATABASE=photoview
      - MARIADB_USER=photoview
      - MARIADB_PASSWORD=photoview
      - MARIADB_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD=yes
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/mysql

name: Audiobookshelf
description: A self-hosted server for audiobooks and podcasts, with mobile apps that stream and sync playback position.
compose:
services:
  audiobookshelf:
    image: ghcr.io/advplyr/audiobookshelf:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "13378:80"
    volumes:
      - ./audiobooks:/audiobooks
      - ./podcasts:/podcasts
      - ./config:/config
      - ./metadata:/metadata

name: Kavita
description: A fast web-based reader for comics, manga, and ebooks that indexes a library folder you point it at.
compose:
services:
  kavita:
    image: jvmilazz0/kavita:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5005:5000"
    volumes:
      - ./manga:/manga
      - ./data:/kavita/config

name: Calibre-Web
description: A web interface for browsing and reading books from an existing Calibre library; it defaults to a non-root user, so config ownership may need adjusting.
compose:
services:
  calibre-web:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/calibre-web:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./books:/books
    ports:
      - "8570:8083"

name: Gotify
description: A simple self-hosted push notification server that apps and scripts can send messages to over a REST API.
compose:
services:
  gotify:
    image: gotify/server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8580:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/app/data

name: PrivateBin
description: A minimalist pastebin, encrypted and decrypted entirely in the browser; the image runs as uid 65534/gid 82, so the data directory needs matching ownership.
compose:
services:
  privatebin:
    image: privatebin/nginx-fpm-alpine:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8590:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/srv/data

name: Baserow
description: A no-code database and spreadsheet tool, an open-source alternative to Airtable, bundled here as a single all-in-one image.
compose:
services:
  baserow:
    image: baserow/baserow:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - BASEROW_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:8071
    ports:
      - "8071:80"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/baserow/data

name: Speedtest Tracker
description: A scheduled internet speed test that charts results over time; it requires an APP_KEY, generated before first run, to encrypt stored data.
compose:
services:
  speedtest-tracker:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/speedtest-tracker:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - APP_KEY=
      - APP_URL=http://localhost:8073
      - DB_CONNECTION=sqlite
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
    ports:
      - "8073:80"

name: Healthchecks
description: A cron job and background task monitor that alerts you when a periodic ping does not arrive; needs PostgreSQL and a superuser created via createsuperuser.
compose:
services:
  healthchecks:
    image: healthchecks/healthchecks:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8088:8000"
    environment:
      - ALLOWED_HOSTS=*
      - SITE_ROOT=http://localhost:8088
      - SECRET_KEY=
      - DB=postgres
      - DB_HOST=db
      - DB_NAME=hc
      - DB_USER=postgres
      - DB_PASSWORD=change-this-too
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=hc
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=change-this-too
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/postgresql

name: Wallabag
description: A read-it-later app that saves web articles for offline, ad-free reading; runs here on its built-in SQLite backend, no external database needed.
compose:
services:
  wallabag:
    image: wallabag/wallabag:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8079:80"
    environment:
      - SYMFONY__ENV__DOMAIN_NAME=http://localhost:8079
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/www/wallabag/data
      - ./images:/var/www/wallabag/web/assets/images

name: Wiki.js
description: A modern team wiki with Markdown editing and access control; it requires its own PostgreSQL database to store pages.
compose:
services:
  wiki:
    image: requarks/wiki:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8075:3000"
    environment:
      - DB_TYPE=postgres
      - DB_HOST=db
      - DB_PORT=5432
      - DB_USER=wikijs
      - DB_PASS=wikijsrocks
      - DB_NAME=wiki
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=wiki
      - POSTGRES_USER=wikijs
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=wikijsrocks
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/postgresql

name: Firefly III
description: A personal finance manager for tracking budgets and expenses; needs an APP_KEY, a 32-character value, and its own MariaDB database.
compose:
services:
  firefly-iii:
    image: fireflyiii/core:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8076:8080"
    environment:
      - APP_KEY=
      - APP_URL=http://localhost:8076
      - DB_CONNECTION=mysql
      - DB_HOST=db
      - DB_DATABASE=firefly
      - DB_USERNAME=firefly
      - DB_PASSWORD=secret_firefly_password
    volumes:
      - ./upload:/var/www/html/storage/upload
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: mariadb:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=firefly
      - MYSQL_USER=firefly
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=secret_firefly_password
      - MYSQL_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD=yes
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/mysql

name: Stirling PDF

compose:
services:
  stirling-pdf:

    ports:
      - "8077:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/configs
      - ./logs:/logs

name: MeTube
description: A web UI for yt-dlp that downloads video, audio, and captions from YouTube and dozens of other sites.
compose:
services:
  metube:
    image: ghcr.io/alexta69/metube:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8091:8081"
    volumes:
      - ./downloads:/downloads

name: Grocy
description: A household ERP for tracking groceries, chores, and batteries to cut down on food waste and missed tasks.

services:
  grocy:

    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
    ports:
      - "9283:80"

name: Homebox
description: A home inventory tracker for possessions and maintenance; won't start without HBOX_AUTH_API_KEY_PEPPER set to 32+ random bytes, try `openssl rand -base64 48`.
compose:
services:
  homebox:
    image: ghcr.io/sysadminsmedia/homebox:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3100:7745"
    environment:
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - HBOX_AUTH_API_KEY_PEPPER=
    volumes:

name: Beszel

services:

      - "8092:8090"

name: ONLYOFFICE Document Server
description: A self-hosted online office suite for editing documents, spreadsheets, and presentations in the browser.
compose:
services:

    image: onlyoffice/documentserver:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8074:80"
    volumes:
      - ./logs:/var/log/onlyoffice

name: code-server
description: VS Code running in the browser for coding from any device; it defaults to a non-root user, so mounted directories may need ownership adjusted.

services:
  code-server:
    image: codercom/code-server:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8078:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./config:/home/coder/.config
      - ./project:/home/coder/project

name: Excalidraw
description: A virtual whiteboard for sketching diagrams by hand; this self-hosted client is stateless, with no sharing or collaboration backend.
compose:
services:
  excalidraw:
    image: excalidraw/excalidraw:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5011:80"

name: Whoogle Search
description: A self-hosted, ad-free proxy for Google search results that strips tracking and ads before the page reaches you.
compose:
services:
  whoogle:
    image: benbusby/whoogle-search:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5010:5000"

name: Snipe-IT
description: An IT asset management system for tracking who has which hardware and license; the container exits on start until you set a real APP_KEY.
compose:
services:
  snipe-it:
    image: snipe/snipe-it:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:

    environment:

      - APP_URL=http://localhost:8072
      - DB_CONNECTION=mariadb
      - DB_HOST=db
      - DB_DATABASE=snipeit
      - DB_USERNAME=snipeit
      - DB_PASSWORD=changeme1234
    volumes:
      - ./storage:/var/lib/snipeit
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: mariadb:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      - MYSQL_DATABASE=snipeit
      - MYSQL_USER=snipeit
      - MYSQL_PASSWORD=changeme1234
      - MYSQL_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD=yes
    volumes:
      - ./db:/var/lib/mysql
